question: Which of the following are members of 15 naturally occurring metallic chemical elements whose atomic numbers are between 57 and 71?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lanthanides**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The atomic number of **lanthanide **is in the** 57-71 range**
 
• It is also called lanthanoid.
 
• It is any of the series of 14 consecutive chemical elements in the periodic table from lanthanum to lutetium i.e. **atomic numbers 57–71 with 57 (Lanthanum) and 71 (Lutetium).**
 
• **Scandium and yttrium **are rare-earth metals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Actinides **are the **14 elements with atomic numbers from 89 to 103.**

 
 
• They are named after the first element in the series, actinium.
 
• The actinides group includes mostly man-made elements with only a few exceptions such as uranium and thorium.
 
• The actinides are most known for the elements** uranium and plutonium which are used in nuclear reactors and nuclear bombs.**
 
 
 
• **Alkali metals** belong to the s-block elements occupying the leftmost side of the periodic table.
 
 
• Alkali metals readily lose electrons, making them the most reactive elements on earth.
 
• In general ‘alkali’ refers to the basic or alkaline nature of their metal hydroxides.
 
• The compounds are called alkali metals because when they react with water they usually form alkalies which are strong bases that can easily neutralize the strong acids.​
 
 
 
• **Halogens **contain 2 gases, one liquid, and 2 solids.
 
 
• Halogens are elements of group 17 in the periodic table consisting of five elements: fluorine (F), chlorine (Cl), bromine (Br), iodine (I), and astatine (At).
 
• Fluorine and chlorine are gases.
